description: Classic ergast.com is shut down. Historical Formula 1 race results, qualifying, drivers, constructors, circuits, and championship standings are available via the community Jolpica Ergast-compatible HTTP API (api.jolpi.ca), which preserves the original Ergast URL paths and JSON/XML response shape.
